note: Wooded Ozarks park on US-54 west of Osceola with cabins, a clubhouse and a 2-acre catch-and-release pond. It is not on Truman Lake. Some sites go to long-term guests. --Claude
summary: Added $40-48 (2026-27 engine), $3.50 reservation fee, 38 sites (was ~40) all FHU pull-through, showers/laundry/wifi/store, year-round, Staylist booking. Confirmed 50A/water/sewer and not waterfront (2-acre pond). Gates and long-stay tests pass.
flags: GATES pass: price - cheapest 23-ft-fit night $40 (30A FHU), $43-45 for 30/50A; all at or under $50 (premium peaks at $48 on a July 2027 Saturday). Presence = own website + phone 417-876-3016 (matches Google). Reviews: Google 4.8 (167); RV Life 4.0 (38, $$, avg $32); the operator's site shows 4.8 from 75 reviews.

LONG-STAY (marketed: the RV Sites page links a 'Contract Workers and Long Term Stays' page (now 404), and the engine lists 'Premium Long Term (39, 40, 42, 44)' - 'live at our beautiful park for years ... Background check is required'). The five tests pass: (1) $40-45 <= $50; (2) single nights sell on the Staylist engine with no application (the background check applies to long-term only); (3) no RV minimum (the 2-night minimum is for cabins); (4) occupancy - Wed 2026-11-18: 12 nightly RV sites free (9 premium + 3 standard; the 30A type not offered); Tue 2027-05-11: premium 11, standard 13 and 30A 6 shown free - far above 1 in 10; (5) not a home community. Only 4 of 38 sites are long-term types.
WATERFRONT not waterfront confirmed: the only water is the park's own pond, stated as '2 acre' (~0.8 ha) on the engine's clubhouse listing - under 2 ha, a pond. Not on Truman Lake.

PIN: stored 37.8941,-93.8040 is the US-54 entrance; the site rows centre at about 37.8960,-93.8035 (~220 m north; the farthest rows ~300 m). Under the 250 m line, so no change proposed; the centre is given in case a closer pin is wanted. Google's 37.89630,-93.80349 is near the clubhouse.
